remarks: AMAZING PRICE!!  and extensive upgrades, and inviting privacy at Skye at Rise. Welcome to 147 Sawbuck in Irvine's Great Park Neighborhoods, where a versatile three-story layout combines comfortable everyday living with exceptional spaces to entertain. A gated front yard and fully landscaped outdoor spaces create a welcoming entrance, while the backyard and covered California room provide inviting settings for outdoor dining and relaxation. Inside, the open-concept kitchen, living, and dining areas are complemented by wood flooring, recessed lighting, and upgraded shutters throughout the home. All four bedrooms are located on the first two floors, including a main-level bedroom and full bath
